highlights_headline: This unreleased update improves Android rendering, memory use, and WebGPU packaging across supported platforms.
highlights_body: It synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh, reduces allocations in image and text-shaping paths, packages WebGPU support into the native library, and corrects front-buffered stream retention.

bullets.detail: Coordinates continuous texture rendering with the display refresh cycle while preserving explicit render requests and lifecycle behavior.
Corrects stream retention so buffered input can be released when it is no longer needed.
Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate allocation, while HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding and feature-string decoding reuse storage without changing results.

bullets.lead: WebGPU implementation packaged with the native library
bullets.detail: Includes the WebGPU C++ support in libSkiaSharp.a, keeping consumer WebAssembly application links free of its C++ compiler settings.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Packaged the WebGPU C++ implementation with the native SkiaSharp library for WebAssembly consumers
